summary: Iteration 3 both-sides testing (i18n 8-language dropdown + 3-card website pricing block + live LLM demos with rotated OPENAI_API_KEY). All 12 acceptance items PASS. Backend pytest suite: 5/5 green (root, email schema, lead schema, empty=422, long-input truncation). Frontend: dropdown shows exactly 8 native-name options in the required order with Magyar default; switching to Deutsch localizes hero H1 ('Wir bauen keine / Chatbots. Wir bauen / Mitarbeiter.'), nav (Agenten/Ablauf/Preise/Fallstudie/KONTAKT), process ('Sechs Schritte, ein menschliches Tor') and pricing ('Webdesign und -entwicklung'); Română and Slovenčina also fully localized (nav + hero + section headings). document.documentElement.lang correctly follows selection (de/ro/sk/es). Persistence via localStorage 'aximbra_lang' confirmed with reload (Español survives). No raw dotted keys or empty text found across de/es/fr/it/ro/sk. Pricing section renders exactly 3 cards pkg-card-0/1/2 with correct HU names + prices (120 000 Ft, 290 000 Ft, 900 000 Ft-tól), net-note under every price, DE 'ab 900 000 Ft' localized 'from' suffix on 3rd card, middle card highlighted with 'Legnépszerűbb' / 'Am beliebtesten' badge, CTA mailto hrefs to aximbra@gmail.com include the package name in the decoded subject, each card has 3 feature bullets. At 360px viewport the pkg-grid collapses to a single column (304px column width) and no horizontal overflow. Both live LLM demos (email + lead) returned populated demo-result-* panels within ~15s. Zero console errors during load or language switching.

Consider adding aria-live to demo-result-* for screen-reader announcements (minor a11y nit, not blocking).
